tagline.en: 100% local-first App Store Connect sales, first-time downloads, review replies & release companion

description.zh-CN: ASC Watcher 是专为 Apple 独立开发者与团队打造的本地优先 App Store Connect 移动工作台。通过设备端 ES256 JWT 直连 Apple 官方接口，实时聚合每日与月度 TSV 报表，精准还原开发者净收益、首次下载量、内购明细、9 大币种折算与前 2 大原始币种透视，并支持在 App 内直接回复用户评论、监控版本审核与 TestFlight 状态、过审一键发布以及 4×2 手机桌面小组件。无中转服务器、无统计 SDK，您的 .p8 私钥 100% 保存在本机。
description.en: ASC Watcher is a privacy-first, local-only App Store Connect sales, review, and release companion for Apple developers. Connecting directly to Apple's official API via on-device ES256 JWT signing, it aggregates daily and monthly TSV reports for net proceeds, calibrated first-time downloads, IAP breakdowns, 9-currency conversions with top-2 original currencies, in-app customer review replies, App Store review & TestFlight monitoring with 1-tap release, and a 4×2 Home Screen Widget. Zero middleman servers—your .p8 key never leaves your phone.

name.zh-CN: 本机 ES256 签名直连 Apple 官方接口
name.en: On-device ES256 JWT direct to Apple API

summary.zh-CN: 您的 Issuer ID、Key ID、Vendor Number 与 .p8 私钥仅保存在手机本地，App 在设备端实时生成 JWT 令牌直连 api.appstoreconnect.apple.com。
summary.en: Your Issuer ID, Key ID, Vendor Number, and .p8 private key never leave your phone. JWT tokens are signed locally to query api.appstoreconnect.apple.com directly.

detail.zh-CN: 市面上不少第三方统计工具要求把 App Store Connect 私钥上传到他们的云端服务器代拉报表，这意味着您的全盘财务数据与后台权限暴露在第三方手中。ASC Watcher 坚持零中转服务器架构，所有网络请求直接发往 Apple 官方接口。
detail.en: Many third-party analytics tools require uploading your App Store Connect private key to their cloud servers. ASC Watcher eliminates middleman risk: every request goes straight from your device to Apple.

name.zh-CN: 精准对齐 ASC 后台的首次下载与内购统计

summary.zh-CN: 严格按 Apple 官方 Product Type Identifier 区分首次下载（1/1F/1T/F1）与内购订阅（IA1/IA9/IAY），剔除自动更新（7/7F/7T）与重装干扰。
summary.en: Strictly separates first-time downloads (1/1F/1T/F1) from In-App Purchases & Subscriptions (IA1/IA9/IAY) while excluding auto-updates (7/7F/7T) and redownloads.

detail.zh-CN: 自动拉取历史月报（MONTHLY）与近期日报（DAILY）并智能去重拼接，同时通过 /v1/apps 补齐零销量新上架应用，并从 iTunes Lookup 自动匹配高清应用图标。
detail.en: Automatically merges historical monthly reports with recent daily reports without overlap, fetches all registered apps via /v1/apps, and resolves HD app icons.

name.zh-CN: 交互式柱状图拆解 + 9 大币种与前二原币透视

summary.zh-CN: 点击柱状图任意一根柱子即可锁定并展开当日由哪几款 App、内购项或国家贡献的明细；支持 9 种目标货币一键折算并并列显示价值最高的前 2 个原始入账币种。
summary.en: Tap any bar to inspect the exact apps, IAPs, or countries for that day; switch between 9 target currencies while viewing the top 2 original settlement currencies side by side.

detail.zh-CN: 严格过滤免费下载行的空币种干扰，只对真实产生开发者净收益（Developer Proceeds != 0）的交易按原始结算币种聚合，既看清折算总额（如 $12.83），又不错过各区真实入账（如 $6.79 + ₹575.55）。
detail.en: Free download rows never pollute currency buckets—only rows with non-zero Developer Proceeds are aggregated into original settlement currencies.

name.zh-CN: 多国用户评分评论查看与 App 内直接回复
name.en: Global customer reviews & direct in-app replies

summary.zh-CN: 直连 /v1/apps/{id}/customerReviews 与 /v1/customerReviewResponses，支持按星级筛选全球用户评论，并在手机端直接编写、修改或删除开发者官方回复。
summary.en: Connects directly to /v1/apps/{id}/customerReviews and /v1/customerReviewResponses so you can filter reviews by star rating and post, edit, or delete official developer replies on the go.

detail.zh-CN: 内置「感谢好评」「采纳建议」「引导联系技术支持」一键快捷回复模板，详情页默认仅展示最新 1 条评论以保持视觉清爽，点击即可展开全量评价并当场回复。
detail.en: Includes 1-tap quick reply templates and keeps the App Detail view clean by showing the latest review by default with 1-tap expansion.

name.zh-CN: 版本审核状态监控、TestFlight 速览与过审一键发布
name.en: App review status, TestFlight builds & 1-tap release

summary.zh-CN: 实时追踪 App Store 版本状态（正在审核、等待审核、被拒、待手动发布、已上架）与 TestFlight 构建状态，当版本处于「过审 · 待手动发布」时可直接在手机上一键发布上架。
summary.en: Track App Store version states (In Review, Waiting for Review, Rejected, Pending Developer Release, Ready for Sale) and TestFlight builds, with 1-tap manual release right from your phone.

detail.zh-CN: 通过官方 POST /v1/appStoreVersionReleaseRequests 接口触发手动上架，无需在外出时临时找电脑登录网页端后台；详情页默认仅展示最新 1 个版本状态，其余历史版本自动折叠。
detail.en: Triggers official POST /v1/appStoreVersionReleaseRequests directly from your device so you can release approved versions anywhere.

name.zh-CN: 4×2 手机系统桌面小组件（Home Screen Widget）

summary.zh-CN: 支持将 4×2 销售与下载看板固定到 iOS 与 Android 手机主屏幕，无需打开 App 即可随时扫一眼开发者净收益、昨日首次下载、累计首次下载与支付笔数。
summary.en: Pin a 4×2 dashboard widget to your iOS or Android home screen to check net developer proceeds, yesterday's downloads, total first-time downloads, and paid transactions at a glance.

detail.zh-CN: 完美适配浅色与深色模式，提供应用内实景预览与一键固定到桌面功能，每次下拉刷新报表即自动同步桌面小组件。
detail.en: Adapts to Light and Dark themes with an in-app live preview and one-tap home screen pinning.

q.zh-CN: ASC Watcher 会把我的 .p8 私钥或销售数据上传到你们的服务器吗？
q.en: Does ASC Watcher upload my .p8 private key or sales data to your servers?

a.zh-CN: 绝对不会。ASC Watcher 没有账号系统，也没有任何自建后端服务器。您输入的 Issuer ID、Key ID、Vendor Number 与 .p8 私钥仅保存在您的手机本地存储中，所有 JWT 签名均在设备本地完成后直接请求 Apple 官方接口（api.appstoreconnect.apple.com）。
a.en: Never. ASC Watcher has no user accounts and zero backend servers. Your Issuer ID, Key ID, Vendor Number, and .p8 private key are stored exclusively on your device. All ES256 JWT tokens are signed locally and sent directly to Apple's official endpoint (api.appstoreconnect.apple.com).

q.zh-CN: 为什么没有配置 API 密钥也能看到演示数据？
q.en: Why can I see data before configuring my API key?

a.zh-CN: 首次打开且未配置凭据时，应用默认提供内置的「演示模式（Demo Mode）」示例数据，方便您直观体验全部图表交互、币种切换、评论回复与版本发布流程。您随时可以在「更多 → API 凭据配置」中填入真实密钥切换为实时数据。
a.en: When no credentials are configured, the app starts in built-in Demo Mode so you can explore interactive charts, currency switching, review replies, and version release workflows right away. Add your real API key anytime under More → API Credentials.

q.zh-CN: 应该给 API Key 分配什么权限角色？
q.en: What role should I assign to my App Store Connect API Key?

a.zh-CN: 如果您只需查看销售与下载报表，在 App Store Connect「用户和访问 → 集成 → App Store Connect API」中分配「财务（Finance）」或「销售和趋势（Sales and Reports）」只读角色即可；如果您还希望在 App 内直接回复用户评论或一键发布过审版本，建议分配「客户支持（Customer Support）」或「App 管理（App Manager）/ 管理（Admin）」角色。
a.en: For sales and download reports only, a read-only Finance or Sales and Reports role is sufficient. To reply to customer reviews or trigger 1-tap version releases from the app, assign Customer Support, App Manager, or Admin.

q.zh-CN: 能在 App 里面直接回复用户评论或发布过审新版本吗？
q.en: Can I reply to customer reviews and release approved versions directly in the app?

a.zh-CN: 可以。进入任意应用详情页，底部的「版本与审核状态」与「用户评分与评论」默认仅展示最新 1 条以保持页面清爽，点击即可展开全部。您可以直接使用快捷模板或自定义文字发布/修改/删除官方开发者回复，也可以对处于「过审 · 待手动发布（PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE）」的版本一键触发立即上架。
a.en: Yes. In any App Detail page, the latest version status and latest customer review are shown cleanly by default with 1-tap expansion. You can post, edit, or delete official developer responses using quick templates, and release versions in PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE state with a single tap.

q.zh-CN: ASC Watcher 怎么收费？满 100 次打开后还能继续免费用吗？
q.en: How does pricing work? Can I still use the app after 100 opens?

a.zh-CN: 可以继续免费使用。前 100 次打开应用完全静默零弹窗、开放全部核心功能。满 100 次后并不是锁死不能用，而是进入 App 时会自动弹出一次 Pro 订阅引导页（带 2 小时冷却保护，不会频繁打扰），您可以手动点击右上角关闭并继续使用全部功能；若您愿意支持独立开发或希望永久消除启动弹窗，可选择 ¥6/月（$0.99）、¥38/年（$4.99）连续订阅，或 ¥68（$9.99）一次性终身买断。
a.en: Yes, you can keep using it. Your first 100 app opens are 100% silent with zero paywall prompts and all features unlocked. After 100 opens, the app gently shows a dismissible Pro upgrade sheet on launch (with a 2-hour cooldown) that you can close anytime to continue using the app, or upgrade to Pro (¥6/mo, ¥38/yr, or ¥68 lifetime) to permanently remove launch prompts.

q.zh-CN: 如何添加手机桌面小组件（Home Screen Widget）？
q.en: How do I add the Home Screen Widget?

a.zh-CN: 进入「更多 → 手机桌面小组件」，可先预览深色/浅色实景效果并点击「一键添加到手机桌面」；也可以长按手机主屏幕空白处，在系统「小组件 / 窗口小工具」列表中找到 ASC Watcher (4×2) 并拖入桌面。
a.en: Go to More → Home Screen Widget to preview the widget in Light/Dark mode and tap 'Pin to Home Screen', or long-press an empty area on your phone's home screen and add the ASC Watcher (4×2) widget from the system widget gallery.
